certification.name: Offensive Azure Operations and Tactics Certification
certification.description: Covers Azure and Entra ID enumeration, authentication and authorization attacks, RBAC and managed identity abuse, cloud lateral movement and persistence. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a live Azure environment followed by 48 hours to submit a report.
certification.currency_note: Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700
